Total AD = unique dealer names after cleaning invisible characters, whitespace-only duplicates, and confirmed encoding typos. E2A AD Active = cumulative quantity ≥ 2 × number of selected months; purchases in every month are not required. The TOTAL row sums distributor rows, so it can exceed the KPI when the same AD name appears under more than one distributor.

No dealer selected yet.
Country AD Active rule: if the dealer purchases in only 1 transaction in the quarter, total quantity must be ≥ 36 tyres. If the dealer purchases more than once, cumulative quantity must be ≥ 16 tyres and there must be at least 2 transactions in the quarter.
Current data limitation: the source file contains Month but no invoice / transaction ID, so this dashboard treats each distinct purchasing month in a quarter as one transaction for this KPI. Line Register, Segment and Pattern filters are applied to the Country AD Active calculation. The Not Registered name list shown on hover/click is intentionally calculated from Not Registered rows and follows Segment/Pattern filters so you can still inspect missing registrations while viewing Registered performance. Only the 100% target is shown inline with Actual. Q1 and Q2 use the 1H 100% target; Q3 YTD uses the 2H 100% target for EPB, OEM, SP (Sompol), MGP, RTY and NKY.

Opportunity
Action-ready opportunities using AD size tiers. Each AD is benchmarked only against stores in the same YTD tyre-volume tier across all Distributors; AD below 500 tyres are excluded.
YTD Jan–Aug · Size-tier benchmark
How opportunity is identified: AD size is based on total YTD tyre quantity and grouped into three commercial tiers: Small = 500–1,499 tyres, Medium = 1,500–4,999 tyres, and Large = 5,000+ tyres. AD below 500 tyres are excluded from Opportunity. Each AD is benchmarked against cross-Distributor peers in the same size tier. CAI Pair Mix = matched Front/Rear CAI tyre quantity ÷ AD total YTD tyre quantity. Peer benchmark uses the median CAI Pair Mix of same-tier peers, then converts that % back into an equivalent tyre quantity for the selected AD size. Example: if a Large AD sells 10,000 tyres YTD and the Large-peer median mix for a CAI pair is 3.0%, the benchmark is 300 tyres. The dashboard excludes obvious distributor-owned/front-counter records and keeps the commercial ranking by estimated opportunity value while showing the quantity gap directly. Compatible vehicle names are fitment context only; they do not prove which vehicle the sold tyre was installed on.
Mission
Approved B2B stores consolidated to store level. Mission registration comes from “Join Mission”. YTD Value is Jan–Aug sell-out, matched by AD Code first and StoreName second.

Store Detail
Distributor Mission AD Code Store Name YTD Value YTD Qty Store Size Sell-out Match Line OA
Matching logic: AD Code exact match first; if unavailable/not found, normalized StoreName is matched within the same Distributor. Duplicate store-name variants (for example BNS Speed / BNS-speed / BNSspeed) are merged to one store before KPI counts. “Not matched” means the store could not be linked confidently to the Jan–Aug sell-out file, so YTD Value is shown as “–” rather than assumed to be zero.
Store Size: relative to matched Mission stores within each Distributor — Large = top 25% YTD Value, Small = bottom 25%, Medium = middle 50%. The top Distributor filter applies to this tab; Month, Line Register, Segment, Pattern and Vehicle filters do not change Mission YTD totals.
